name: storage-v0.5.0
body:
This is storage release [storage-v0.5.0](https://github.com/rabbithole-app/v2/releases/tag/storage-v0.5.0) for commit [221abdf40c6daba19f7f564de20a40bda2820d64](https://github.com/rabbithole-app/v2/commit/221abdf40c6daba19f7f564de20a40bda2820d64).

## What's Changed

Storage release with 1 feature, 2 fixes.

### Features

- Serve storage deployments and top-ups from backend cycles reserve. ([7b2bf73](https://github.com/rabbithole-app/v2/commit/7b2bf7360c13997879e42cb8ecde21d7ae3c96b3))

### Fixes

- Switch Solana mainnet RPC to Alchemy. ([221abdf](https://github.com/rabbithole-app/v2/commit/221abdf40c6daba19f7f564de20a40bda2820d64))
- Freeze downloader stable HTTP types to restore mainnet upgrade compatibility. ([d1a318e](https://github.com/rabbithole-app/v2/commit/d1a318e7d0cef0788d3852251df6086630299715))

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rabbithole-app/v2/compare/storage-v0.4.0...storage-v0.5.0

## Wasm Verification

To rebuild the storage WASM module and verify its hash, run:

```sh
git checkout 221abdf40c6daba19f7f564de20a40bda2820d64
npm install -g @icp-sdk/icp-cli@1.0.0 @icp-sdk/ic-wasm ic-mops@2.14.1
apps/backend/scripts/build-storage-release-wasm.sh
shasum -a 256 apps/backend/.icp/cache/artifacts/encrypted-storage
```

Expected storage WASM sha256: `c7abdba0b79133797771a7498bec5247bbf4f978ab15c3815abb34be31f2487d`

The machine-readable release contract is attached as `storage-release.json`.
